issue_context.title: Ports with duplicate names should not be allowed to exist in the pod.
issue_context.body:
### What happened?

The same port name exists in the pod, but it is not allowed in the document.


https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/workload-resources/pod-v1/#ports


![image](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/assets/89568107/a12f4f70-ff90-4960-a5b7-2f8d64ae7ffb)


![image](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/assets/89568107/15576707-f22d-4dfe-bc96-1ca50f6d7d8b)



### What did you expect to happen?

Each named port in a pod must have a unique name.

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

I think it can't be repaired and there will be problems with upgrading.

Recap:
- duplicate port names within a single container are NOT allowed
- duplicate port names within a pod but in different containers IS allowed, without any warning, but should not be
- duplicate port names within a pod but in containers and initContainers IS allowed, without any warning, but should not be

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/122170 adds warnings for both cases.

review_comments: use the existing VisitContainersWithPath visitor to do this check

With https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-node/753-sidecar-containers/README.md SidecarContainer enabled, should this include `initContainer` if the restart policy is always.
You mean after enabling SidecarContainer, if the restart policy is always "Always", then initContainer should be included. Isn't initContainer included in other cases? @pacoxu

There is an example in the KEP
```
kind: Pod
spec:
  initContainers:
  - name: vault-agent
    image: hashicorp/vault:1.12.1
  - name: istio-proxy
    image: istio/proxyv2:1.16.0
    args: ["proxy", "sidecar"]
    restartPolicy: Always
  containers:
  ...
```

In the new proposal, istio-proxy is a sidecar container and valut-agent is not. 

This is container's restartPolicy, not pod's restartPolicy.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/7fe31be11fbe9b44af262d5f5cffb1e73648aa96/pkg/apis/core/pods/helpers.go#L35-L50

@yanfeng1992 pointed out that `VisitContainersWithPath` covers `containers`, `initContainers` and `ephemeralContainers`. You can resolve this comment. Sorry for disturb.
